mentions.name: pg-essays
mentions.description: This project converts Paul Graham's essays into LaTeX, generating four volumes, each with its own mobile and PDF formats.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm converting PG's essays into latex. It generates 4 "volumes", each with it's own mobile + PDF. It's still early, but am really happy with it so far!
